newsitem.title: UK: Capel expands Euro equity cover.
newsitem.headline: Capel expands Euro equity cover.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said on Wednesday it had hired two senior stock analysts to beef up its pan-European equity coverage.

Thomas Kullman, 36, will join as a Scandinavian analyst from Swedbank in Stockholm, where he was head of equity research, and Rod Hinkel, 35, will join as a German analyst from Paribas Capital Markets where he was head of German research.
Capel also said it had hired Chris Hoare, 26, as a Swiss analyst from NatWest Securities in Zurich. He and Hinkel will be based in London while Kullman will be located in Stockholm.
"These appointments substantially strengthen our coverage of key European markets," Capel said in a statement.

Capel also listed four other recent analyst hires. The brokerage recruited drinks analyst Charles Winston from BZW, smaller companies analyst Charles Matthias from Credit Lyonnais, capital goods analyst Rupert Warburton from management consultancy Booz Allen and food retail analyst Kate Calvert from Robert Fleming.
